versions.changelog:
wechat-sou v1.0.1

- Added search and CLI support for both WeChat articles and videos.
- Introduced JSON Schema files for article/video search input and output for LLM/CLI integration.
- Provided detailed command examples and parameters for enhanced usability.
- Expanded documentation with references/options and comprehensive CLI command usage.
- Removed deprecated skill-card.md.

This update enables flexible, real-time WeChat article and video searching via both direct CLI and structured API/LLM calls.
